item.heralisz_n07.sylvorn_antler.lore: Torn from Sylvorn's skull. The wood is still warm.
item.heralisz_n07.sylvorn_heart.lore: It still beats. Once a minute, slowly.
item.heralisz_n07.sylvorn_mask_shard.lor: A piece of the stag skull that hid its real face.
item.heralisz_n07.petrified_bark.lore: Hard as stone, cold as a grave.
item.heralisz_n07.ruin_fang.lore: Hollow. Something still drips from it.
item.heralisz_n07.ruin_venom.lore: Warm in the hand, like a heart.
item.heralisz_n07.ruin_silk.lore: Stronger than steel, sticky as fear.
item.heralisz_n07.frost_fang.lore: It burns the hand that holds it with cold.
item.heralisz_n07.permafrost_heart.lore: Frozen for ten thousand years. It will never melt.
item.heralisz_n07.frost_scale.lore: Hard and clear like deep-sea ice.
item.heralisz_n07.eternal_ice.lore: Even in the sun, not a drop runs.
item.heralisz_n07.vulkhar_wing.lore: The membrane is still warm. It smells of sulphur.
item.heralisz_n07.magma_heart.lore: It glows in the dark, like an ember that refuses to die.
item.heralisz_n07.blazing_scale.lore: Black above, red below, burning all over.
item.heralisz_n07.plague_mask.lore: The filter is saturated. What it held back still breathes inside.
item.heralisz_n07.plague_canister.lore: Empty. Almost. Whatever you do, don't unscrew it.
item.heralisz_n07.plague_hook.lore: Rusted, chipped. It has dragged its share of survivors.
item.heralisz_n07.plague_spores.lore: They glow in the dark, looking for a host.
item.heralisz_n07.n07_respirator.lore: The filters are burnt from the inside. He stopped breathing air a long time ago.
item.heralisz_n07.n07_core.lore: It still beats, slowly. Don't keep it close to you.
item.heralisz_n07.n07_badge.lore: Dr ██████, head chemist. Clearance level 5. The photo has melted.
item.heralisz_n07.trinitite.lore: Green glass born of the meltdown. Still warm. The counter goes wild.
item.heralisz_n07.knight_helm.lore: There was never anyone inside. Only the oath.
item.heralisz_n07.soul_ember.lore: It burns without consuming. It remembers a name nobody knows.
item.heralisz_n07.ashen_blade.lore: Still warm. The runes light up when you grip it too hard.
item.heralisz_n07.ember_root.lore: It is still looking for something to inhabit.
item.heralisz_n07.n07_keycard.use: Swipe it through the Sector 7 terminal.
item.heralisz_n07.purge_wheel.lore: Missing from the quarantine station's main valve.
item.heralisz_n07.purge_wheel.use: Mount it on the purge valve by the settling basin.
item.heralisz_n07.oath_ember.lore: An ember that never dies. It swore to relight the chapel.
item.heralisz_n07.oath_ember.use: Drop it in the brazier at the Knight's feet.
item.heralisz_n07.ancestral_seed.lore: Runes grow through it like veins. It beats, faintly.
item.heralisz_n07.ancestral_seed.use: Plant it before the monolith of the sylvan mound.
item.heralisz_n07.brood_egg.lore: Warm, heavy, wrapped in silk. Something moves inside.
item.heralisz_n07.brood_egg.use: Lay it on the altar beneath the cocoon of the Ruin Nest.
shrine.heralisz_n07.n07.need: Terminal locked — Level 5 access card required.
shrine.heralisz_n07.n07.awake: ACCESS DENIED — subject already out of containment.
shrine.heralisz_n07.peste.need: The valve has no handwheel. You need a purge handwheel.
shrine.heralisz_n07.peste.awake: The gas is already out. So is he.
shrine.heralisz_n07.peste.cooldown: The vats are still refilling (%s min).
shrine.heralisz_n07.chevalier.need: The brazier is cold. It needs an Ember of the Oath.
shrine.heralisz_n07.chevalier.awake: The Knight stands. The oath burns again.
shrine.heralisz_n07.chevalier.cooldown: The ashes are still warm (%s min).
shrine.heralisz_n07.sylvorn.need: The monolith awaits an ancestral seed.
shrine.heralisz_n07.sylvorn.awake: The beast already prowls the mound.
shrine.heralisz_n07.mere.need: The altar demands a brood egg.
shrine.heralisz_n07.mere.cooldown: The cocoon is being rewoven (%s min).
command.heralisz_n07.dungeon.unknown: Unknown dungeon (n07, peste, chevalier, sylvorn, mere, glacivore, vulkhar).
decor.heralisz_n07.hint.floor: Place on the ground, facing you.
decor.heralisz_n07.hint.rail: Place it on a rail: it sits on the track.
decor.heralisz_n07.hint.drop: Right-click with an empty hand: lengthen the chain.
block.heralisz_n07.storm_lantern.desc: Its flame dances behind the glass as it sways on its chain.
block.heralisz_n07.mine_lamp.desc: Enamel shade and caged bulb: light falls in a soft cone.
block.heralisz_n07.string_lights.desc: Seven blocks of warm bulbs hanging in festoons.
block.heralisz_n07.wall_lamp.desc: A caged cast-iron bulkhead light screwed to the wall.
block.heralisz_n07.floodlight.desc: A tripod floodlight throwing a white beam across the area.
block.heralisz_n07.fire_barrel.desc: A rusty drum burning scrap wood: survivors warm up around it.
block.heralisz_n07.locomotive.desc: An old mining steam engine, 9 blocks long, headlamp lit, steam and smoke.
block.heralisz_n07.freight_wagon.desc: A goods wagon tagged HERALIS, door ajar on supply crates.
block.heralisz_n07.ore_wagon.desc: A riveted steel hopper heaped with coal and ore.
block.heralisz_n07.mine_cart.desc: A tub full of ore, a pickaxe across it and a lantern hooked on.
block.heralisz_n07.buffer_stop.desc: End of the line: striped buffer beam and blinking red lamp.
block.heralisz_n07.neon_sign.desc: Toxic-green neon tubes, one tired letter buzzing: the server's sign.
block.heralisz_n07.station_sign.desc: A blue enamel platform sign on two iron posts.
block.heralisz_n07.welcome_sign.desc: Hand-painted planks, a bloody handprint and barbed wire.
block.heralisz_n07.signpost.desc: Painted arrows: SPAWN, MINE, EXIT, RED ZONE.
block.heralisz_n07.safezone_sign.desc: Safe zone, no weapons: the entrance of the spawn.
block.heralisz_n07.danger_sign.desc: A bullet-riddled plate on a scrap of fence: keep out.
block.heralisz_n07.notice_board.desc: Missing posters, a map, survival rules: camp news.
block.heralisz_n07.banner.desc: A red pennant bearing the server's emblem, gently waving.
block.heralisz_n07.military_tent.desc: A large khaki tent with a camp bed and a lantern inside.
block.heralisz_n07.generator.desc: It shakes, smokes and hums: the camp's power.
block.heralisz_n07.radio_station.desc: A crackling military radio, antenna up, lamp lit.
block.heralisz_n07.workbench.desc: A workbench with a vise, hanging tools and a work lamp.
block.heralisz_n07.supply_crates.desc: Stencilled HERALIS military crates: rations and ammo.
block.heralisz_n07.fuel_drums.desc: 200-litre drums and a jerrycan: the camp's fuel.
block.heralisz_n07.sandbags.desc: A curved wall of canvas sandbags, 3 blocks wide.
block.heralisz_n07.czech_hedgehog.desc: A steel anti-tank obstacle wrapped in barbed wire.
block.heralisz_n07.wrecked_car.desc: A rusted old sedan: smashed windows, door torn off.
block.heralisz_n07.mine_support.desc: A timber gallery frame with a lantern hanging from the cap.
command.heralisz_n07.shrine.busy: This shrine is already in a ritual or a fight.
item.heralisz_n07.seismic_charge.lore: Frosted, heavy, a red light blinking. What it wakes sleeps under the ice.
item.heralisz_n07.seismic_charge.use: Arm it in the seismic drill on the shore of the Boreal Station's frozen lake.
item.heralisz_n07.forge_core.lore: It burns without a flame, and beats like a heart.
item.heralisz_n07.forge_core.use: Lay it on the anvil of the Sunken Forge, at the edge of the lava lake.
shrine.heralisz_n07.glacivore.need: The drill needs a seismic charge.
shrine.heralisz_n07.glacivore.awake: The ice has already given way.
shrine.heralisz_n07.glacivore.cooldown: The lake is freezing over again (%s min).
shrine.heralisz_n07.vulkhar.need: The anvil demands a forge core.
shrine.heralisz_n07.vulkhar.awake: It has already risen from the lava.
cine.heralisz_n07.spawn.title: SUBJECT N-07
cine.heralisz_n07.phase2.title: PHASE II
cine.heralisz_n07.phase3.title: PHASE III
cine.heralisz_n07.death.title: SUBJECT N-07
scene.heralisz_n07.intro.maxis1: Subject N-07... my chief chemist. After the 115 accident, we sealed him beneath the factory.
scene.heralisz_n07.intro.maxis2: Breslau, 1945. Group 935 buried its mistakes here. Do not wake this one.
scene.heralisz_n07.intro.maxis3: Sector 7. Element 115 kept him alive... if you can call that living.
scene.heralisz_n07.intro.maxis4: The valves! The 115 is flowing back into the channels... it feeds him!
scene.heralisz_n07.intro.maxis5: Containment is failing. Put him down before he contaminates the whole facility!
scene.heralisz_n07.p2.maxis: The 115 is reacting to his wounds! Don't bunch up!
scene.heralisz_n07.p3.maxis: He has tapped the tank's core... the power is failing! Aim for the glow in his chest!
scene.heralisz_n07.outro.maxis1: Vitrified... Subject N-07 is no more. I am closing his file.
scene.heralisz_n07.outro.maxis2: The 935 teleporter is charged. Get back up to the factory: the night is not over.
scene.heralisz_n07.outro.title: TERMINATED
command.heralisz_n07.zombies.none: No bound N-07 hall nearby (/n07 zombies pose).
command.heralisz_n07.zombies.busy: A fight is already running in this hall.
